notes.title: New May 2019 Camp Deadwood Update
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31641243/3022d66ebb2b1a8921f9bae4881845539a4f5d44.png

Summer is over and the kids have all gone home...you are alone in Camp Deadwood. Its quiet...a little too quiet 

New Midnightland May 2019 Update featuring 

1.New weapons system: 
Switch between pistol, assault rifle and rocket launcher. Special ammo for each weapon.

2.New ammo collection units for each weapon. 
Easily identify ammo when you need it most in game.

3.New steady camera system: 
A lot of people mentioned they found the previous camera setup annoying so the new camera system is very stable and makes the game play more stable and enjoyable. 

4.New demo level of Camp Deadwood: 
Step inside the scariest summer camp in Midnightland! Camp Deadwood is a new attraction and you can explore the camp, cabins and fight for your life right now. The area and Camp Killer will be updated more in the future. Feel the fear as your stalked by the Camp Killer and other demonic creatures. 

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31641243/fa067c1b5887fef468ede3a190649b14e4262053.png

notes.title: ZOMBIE SOLDIER
notes.content:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/954780/Zombie_Soldier/

Face off as the Zombie Soldier against the undead army. Explore graveyards and army bases to eradicate them all. Shoot, jump and destroy in this simple retro styled 2.5D metroidvania throwback game. A casual yet challenging introduction to the Zombie Soldier world.

1. Easy to learn classic A+B button controls. 

2. Play with Gamepad or Keyboard + Mouse.

3. Controller support for that retro gameplay feel. 

4. A retro and modern graphics mashup.

5. Simple yet challenging arcade and 80's home console throwback styled game.

Kill or be killed and fight hard to pass each challenging level. Different paths can be taken and the levels get harder as you progress. Shoot, jump and kill to survive while collecting blood viles to escape permadeath in each level.

notes.title: New Weapons System In Next Update
notes.content:
I've been working on a new weapons system for Midnightland this month to add more options to combat. Choose between Pistol, Assault Rifle, No Weapon Mode and Rocket Launcher. This and more fun including Funko's Funhouse will be added to Midnightland in the next update coming soon.

-The Skullmaster-
